$comment: MEASURED indoor room polygons from OpenStreetMap (ODbL). This is the only real room geometry that exists for this site in open data. Everything else in the twin's interiors is generated and badged synthetic.
$attributionComment: `buildingOsmId` is the building whose real footprint contains the room's centroid. It is null only where the AOI did not ask for attribution, which is safe only where the campus boxes contain no other institution's interiors. In Munich they do — TUM's Stammgelände is 700 m from LMU's Hauptgebäude — and attribution is the difference between 527 rooms and 952.
